items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: through Jerry Brightman, the same guy that didn't do too well for me in some situations, and did very well for me in other situations.

ctx.x: Brightman, that was the name he was born with, but he changed it to Herbert J. Morrison.
He would write things like Pete Rugulo's the greatest writer I've heard and he doesn't have to wear a beard to be noticed.
